description: This file defines the Goteo Controller class TemplatesSubController within the Admin namespace, responsible for managing email templates in the Goteo project. It includes methods to list and edit templates, handle permissions, and interact with Template and User models.

classes.name: TemplatesSubController
classes.description: Controller class for managing email templates in the admin interface, with methods for listing and editing templates.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access this controller, restricted to master node.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles editing of a template, including saving changes and managing translation status.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of all templates with filtering options.
